content:
A **Mud Cookie** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

A baked good invented by Delbert Winters using post-War ingredients. Consuming it will give one a burst of energy (equivalent to 180 Action Points).

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Blackwater Brew (1) Mirelurk Egg (1) Razorgrain (2) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned from plan/recipe Recipe: Delbert's Mud Cookie | | Mud Cookie (1) | 

It can be crafted at any Cooking Station with the correct ingredients, after learning the Recipe.
